quest.title: Guy in the Background
quest.rewards_formatted: Apple x9, Suspicious Steak x3, Milk x10, Delicious "Pile 'Em Up" x2, Delicious Steak x3

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: *sigh* Standing here on guard duty, day in, day out... It really doesn't give me much detail to write about...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: ...In fact, it gives me precisely zero details to write about.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, um... My father — his name is Tunner, he works at Dawn Winery. He was thrilled when I joined the Knights of Favonius; every time he writes to me now it's all he ever asks about...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: But all I do is guard the gate! And a side gate at that... We hardly ever have anyone coming through this way.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Obviously my father is eagerly anticipating big news of my heroic exploits... Meanwhile, here I am managing the affairs of a gate.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: His health isn't great, and I'm a bit concerned that he'd take a turn for the worse if he knew the reality of my situation. So when I write to him, I tell him that I'm out there with the cream of the crop, fighting battles and all that...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Now I've got myself into a position where I'm forever telling him all these tall tales without a shred of evidence, and I think he's starting to have his doubts.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: If you're preparing to go off on an adventure, could you bring me back a trophy? It would help bolster the credibility of my letter...

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Thank you so much.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: There might not be much room for advancement when you're guarding a side gate, but this is the job I've been assigned to.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: I'm not about to abandon my post... If I lose this job, my father loses his mind...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: With a trophy to go with the letter, my father's sure to be convinced.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of trophy do you want?

talks.objective: Give the trophy and letter to Tunner

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Greetings, honored guest! Welcome to the Dawn Winery...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This letter is from Guy.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He wrote me a letter? ...And he got you to deliver it?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: So he's been out vanquishing hilichurls with the other knights, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He's only just joined up. Is he really going on quests already?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He took this as a trophy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That Mr. Guy is a pretty mega awesome fighter. He beat up a whole camp of hilichurls just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were nearby, we saw the whole thing with our own eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Oh, I see. Erm... It really is from a hilichurl, then...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Hmph, it's not much of a trophy though. If I was any younger I'd have no problem going out and getting one myself!

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: But I suppose it shows the young'un is trying his best.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Honored guest, thank you for your trouble! Would you care to rest here for a while?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Of course, you must be anxious to get back. Don't let me keep you, then.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Please, take these for the journey. And you can keep the trophy, too — an old man like me doesn't have any use for it.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: The Knights of Favonius... Keep at it, you young rascal.

choices.text: Do you want to send him a reply?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: No... he'll need to try a bit harder than that!

talks.objective: Give the trophy and letter to Tunner

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Greetings, honored guest! Welcome to the Dawn Winery...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This letter is from Guy.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He wrote me a letter? ...And he got you to deliver it?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He says he's fought in many battles alongside the other knights, out in the wild...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: But he only just joined. How on earth did he suddenly become such a seasoned warrior?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He took this as a trophy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mr. Guy is a super-duper warrior! The hilichurls had him surrounded on all sides... But he didn't bat an eyelid, he just coolly worked his way through them one by one!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were nearby, we saw the whole thing with our own eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Goodness... Well, he's certainly been working hard... This is the genuine article...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: And from the looks of it... these are hard to come by.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: The young'un seems to have learned the meaning of grit, then... He's growing up, finally...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Honored guest, thank you for your trouble! If you could wait here a moment, you must let me fetch you something to drink?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Okay... You need to get back, I assume. Then don't let me hold you up.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Please, take these for the journey. And you can keep the trophy, too — an old man like me doesn't have any use for it.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: If he keeps up the good work, he'll have a bright future ahead of him...

choices.text: Do you want to send him a reply?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Erm... No, I'll leave it. That young rascal is probably too busy to read it, in any case.

talks.objective: Give the trophy and letter to Tunner

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Greetings, honored guest! Welcome to the Dawn Winery...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This letter is from Guy.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He wrote me a letter? ...And he got you to deliver it?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Dear father... Defeated a group of slimes... Here's hoping that's the last Dawn Winery sees of them...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Wow, it was only a throwaway comment I made about that, but he really took it to heart...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He took this as a trophy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mr. Guy squashed those slimes to smithereens without even breaking a sweat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was all over in seconds. Bish bash bosh. He moved like lightning!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And after he'd beat them he just looked at the carnage he'd left behind and said, "maybe now my father can finally have some peace..."

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well if he's got the time to worry about me, his job must be too idle.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: At least he's becoming more mature now though. More knightly.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Honored guest, thank you for your trouble... Would you care to rest here for a while?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: You're in a rush to get back? Then I won't delay you.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Please, take these for the journey. And you can keep the trophy, too — an old man like me doesn't have any use for it.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Tell him to keep up the good work from me. And that he should visit home when he has the time...

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: In fact, no, just tell him to keep working hard.

choices.text: Do you want to send him a reply?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Uh... Not right now. I'll write to him soon though.

talks.objective: Give the trophy and letter to Tunner

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Greetings, honored guest! Welcome to the Dawn Winery...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This letter is from Guy.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He wrote me a letter? ...And he got you to deliver it?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Hilichurl shaman... I have heard the folks at the winery talk about them.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He's already going up against that kind of enemy at his level!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He took this as a trophy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those hilichurl shamans might be real tough guys... But fortunately Guy was an even tougher guy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Honestly, he threw them around like ragdolls. They didn't last long!

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Well, well, well... My young'un's becoming more of a knight by the day.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: If he keeps this up, he might just make it big time!

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: If you could please wait here a moment; put your feet up while I get you a bite to eat...

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Oh, you have other business to attend to? I do hope it didn't put you out too much to come all this way just for an old man like me...

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Please, take these for the journey. And you can keep the trophy, too — an old man like me doesn't have any use for it.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Finally, the family's fortunes are taking a turn for the better...

choices.text: Do you want to send him a reply?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Hmm... I won't bother, the young rascal's probably got far better things to do than read a letter from his old man.

talks.objective: Give the trophy and letter to Tunner

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Greetings, honored guest! Welcome to the Dawn Winery...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This letter is from Guy.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He wrote me a letter? ...And he got you to deliver it?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Fought bitterly... Awarded a commendation...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Hmph, my young'un's always been an arrogant show-off... I would have thought he'd know to curb it in now that he's a Knight of Favonius and not a little boy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He took this as a trophy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guy defeated a suuuper scary monster!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were right there beside him, fighting tooth and nail! It was a hard-won battle...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: I've heard of them before... That rascal! Taking on monsters of that caliber, it's just reckless.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: He got lucky this time, but he might not be next time... I need to teach him a lesson. Ambition is great, but recklessness simply won't do!

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: That said, the Knights of Favonius must be pleased to have found someone like this... Anyway — can I get you a drink?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: As it happens, I have a bottle here from the boss himself. It's still unopened.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Oh... Yes of course, you need to be on your way. Don't let me hold you up... You will take a little food for the journey though, won't you?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Please, take these for the journey. And you can keep the trophy, too — an old man like me doesn't have any use for it.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Knights of Favonius... What was I thinking, did I put too much pressure on him?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: There's no need to put his life on the line like that...

choices.text: Do you want to send him a reply?

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: I'll write him a letter shortly. I need to tell that rascal he needs to not get ahead of himself just because he's shown a flair for combat. It would be terrible if something happened to him...

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Sorry, you don't need to be subjected to my ramblings. I will let you go now...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Let me see... Start me off with a firm arrowhead this time round.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: I've heard from the fellow knights that you can find them on the bodies of hilichurls. It's not like I've had the chance to test that theory out in battle though...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: They say that you find them all the time... Even then, I don't have the chance to get one myself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: All of this because my father says things like, "the future of our family rests on your shoulders..."

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: When you've found it, I'd be grateful if you could deliver it to my father for me, along with the letter itself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, and please don't open the letter. My father is quite sensitive to things like that — he'll think it's been tampered with.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: This time help me look for a Damaged Mask, will ya?

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Supposedly you can find them on the bodies of a lot of hilichurls... Not that I have ever done that myself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: It should be enough to stop my father from worrying — that is, as long as you lead him to believe that I didn't actually do nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: ...Even though I never DO do anything besides guard this here gate.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: When you've found it, I'd be grateful if you could deliver it to my father for me, along with the letter itself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, and please don't open the letter. My father is quite sensitive to things like that — he'll think it's been tampered with.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Let's see... Get me some Slime Condensate this time.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: My fellow knights inform me that every time you finish dealing with a slime, the most annoying thing is then dealing with the Slime Condensate.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: I've also heard that slimes are always cropping up around the Dawn Winery. I'm sure it will please my father to see evidence of me supposedly having fought them off.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: When you've found it, I'd be grateful if you could deliver it to my father for me, along with the letter itself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, and please don't open the letter. My father is quite sensitive to things like that — he'll think it's been tampered with.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: This is a bit of an ask, but this time maybe you could get me a divining scroll.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: I hear that hilichurl shamans sometimes carry them around. I don't think they use them for anything though.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: I would love to see for myself... But as long as this gate's around, I won't have the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: When you've found it, I'd be grateful if you could deliver it to my father for me, along with the letter itself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, and please don't open the letter. My father is quite sensitive to things like that — he'll think it's been tampered with.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Erm... This might be a bit of an outlandish request, but can you get me a heavy horn?

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Apparently those heftier-looking hilichurls tend to carry them around.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: My fellow knights say they're very intimidating as enemies go, and that it takes everything you've got to defeat one in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: My dad would be thrilled at the sight of a war trophy taken from one of them. But since it's highly doubtful I'd ever have the chance to pick one up myself... all I can do is ask for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: When you've found it, I'd be grateful if you could deliver it to my father for me, along with the letter itself.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, and please don't open the letter. My father is quite sensitive to things like that — he'll think it's been tampered with.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Have you delivered the letter and trophy to my father?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Firm arrowheads can be found on the bodies of defeated hilichurls. Hilichurl Shooters, to be specific.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: When you've found it, please deliver the trophy and letter to my father.

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: This is all because my dad says things like "the whole family is counting on you," and "I believe you're going to become the strongest knight in all of Mondstadt one day..."

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: And yet right now all I'm good for is guarding this gate. I wonder how things will go in future...

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder what I should do...
